items.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I remember a recording, which I’m sure you’ve heard, Don Ellis “Live at the Fillmore East.”

ctx.x: Okay. I’m glad to hear that. Go back to a big rewind. Do you recall a specific moment or moments when you were young where you heard something — you mentioned when you were at North Texas State, but even before that — was there something that you said what is that, I need to do that, or I want to find out more about that? © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-

I remember a recording, which I’m sure you’ve heard, Don Ellis “Live at the Fillmore East.” I remember getting up in the morning because I was in the — what was that music club where you got records in the mail?
